overlays.label: Dynamic Tax Loss Harvesting
overlays.frequency: Ongoing; market-derived thresholds that account for volatility
overlays.approach: Opportunistically harvests losses in eligible CIO ETF strategies; replacement ETFs keep the allocation and risk profile
overlays.eligible_investments: Only eligible CIO strategies that consist solely of ETFs.
